upstream_execution_contract.execution: Persistent per-agent Node.js VM context in a separate utility worker process; each script runs in an async IIFE. No page document/window. Globals persist across calls.
upstream_execution_contract.deadlines: 30 seconds synchronous VM timeout; 45 seconds asynchronous inactivity timeout reset by API.output/createAttachment; 3 minutes hard wall-clock cap.
upstream_execution_contract.filesystem: Mount-prefixed paths and per-mount read/list/create/edit/delete permissions. att is read-only to fs; new attachments use API.createAttachment. Filesystem changes emit diff notifications.
upstream_execution_contract.network: fetch uses credential placeholders with origin-gated substitution; HTTPS importModule fetches/caches bundled modules. No raw provider keys should be made page globals.
upstream_execution_contract.not_exposed: Raw process/child_process, net/http/https/http2/tls/dns, worker_threads/vm/os and other blocked modules. Shell execution remains a separate native tool.

observed.setInterrupted: Successfully interrupted a bounded infinite-loop probe from another native thread.

qjsengine_probe.conclusion: QJSEngine cannot directly execute current upstream async-IIFE scripts. A globalThis alias is simple, but async syntax/transpilation and host APIs would be substantial compatibility work.

native_worker_candidate.reason: Modern ECMAScript including async functions; embeddable native C API with memory/stack limits and interrupt hooks.
native_worker_candidate.windows_build: VERIFIED: native GCC 16.2.0 MinGW64 static C engine and QtCore C++ worker compile/link/run. No Qt, QuickJS, libstdc++ or libwinpthread DLL imports; Windows system DLL imports remain.
native_worker_candidate.recommended_shape: Separate native worker process with one bounded runtime/context per agent, a controlled promise/job queue, deadline watchdog, and correlated IPC to the C++ host for CDP, mounted filesystem, attachments, network and app messaging.
native_worker_candidate.compatibility_work: Implement and test the actual upstream host APIs and required Node-module behavior. A JavaScript engine alone is not a Node.js compatibility layer. Do not expose the engine's unrestricted OS/stdio/process modules. Preserve origin-scoped credential substitution in the native network broker.
native_worker_candidate.status: Native executeSandboxJs subset implemented and tested. See audit/sandbox-native.json for tested behavior and remaining upstream gaps. Full Node/API parity is not established.
